content:
lexi_customer: Hey team — our helpdesk integration started returning 400s for `ticket.create` calls since ~2026-03-15 14:20 UTC. ~30% of calls fail; others succeed. No code changes on our side.

alicia_cs: Sorry to hear that, @lexi_customer — can you paste one failing request payload + the exact error you see?

lexi_customer: Sure — here's the failing body and the response we get:```json
{
  "tool": "helpdesk.create_ticket",
  "args": {
    "title": "Order charged twice",
    "description": "Customer was charged 2x",
    "assignee": "john@example.com"
  }
}
```Response: `400 Bad Request`
Body: `{ "error": "FunctionRequest validation failed: missing required property 'assignee_id'" }`

matt_support: Huh. Our current helpdesk function schema v2 requires `assignee_id` (integer) and `priority` (optional). That payload looks like v1 (assignee email).

alicia_cs: @matt_support any idea why the model would produce v1 args now? We didn't change customer prompts.

sam_engineer: Quick note from poking repro logs: some requests coming from this customer include a system-level fewshot example that shows the old schema. Eg the conversation context contains a system example blob with:```json
{
  "tool": "helpdesk.create_ticket",
  "args": {
    "title": "...",
    "assignee": "support@oldcompany.com"
  }
}
```Looks like the model is copying that example into function args (schema bleed).

alicia_cs: Where is that system example coming from? Customer-side or our docs/templates?

lexi_customer: We do include some system-level examples in our prompt to improve phrasing. We thought they were harmless examples — they might be old.

priya_infra: Two more oddities from infra logs: (1) Between 14:19–14:26 UTC a subset of this customer's requests were routed to a regional fallback model due to a short quota throttle (billing cap triggered), and (2) there were a few `401` auth failures due to a token rotation event at 14:22. Fallback model + old example mixing could explain intermittent behavior.

matt_support: Repro steps I used:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"model":"assistant-fn","input":"create ticket","system_examples":[{"tool":"helpdesk.create_ticket","args":{"assignee":"old@ex.com","title":"x"}}]}'
```When the system_examples includes the old shape, the returned function call uses `assignee` instead of `assignee_id`. If I remove system_examples it returns the v2 shape.

sam_engineer: Root cause hypothesis: customer-supplied system examples contain legacy function examples. The model is prioritizing examples (fewshot) over the registered function schema, producing mismatched args. When their traffic hit fallback model (different model weights/behavior) behavior changed intermittently.

alicia_cs: OK — what are mitigations we can advise the customer right now?

matt_support: Short-term: remove legacy examples from system messages for any requests that rely on function calling. Add server-side validation to reject/transform `assignee` -> look up id and convert. Also ask them to ensure they pass `X-Model-Policy: enforce_function_schema` header if using hosted API — that forces the model to respect registered function param names.

sam_engineer: Medium-term: eng-runtime should add an optional automatic schema-normalizer: when a function call matches known tool name but arg types mismatch, attempt canonical mapping (email->user_id lookup) and return a deterministic `400` with conversion suggestion if mapping fails. Also log example context that caused the bleed for debugging.

priya_infra: I'll confirm the quota/billing routing details and fix the short window where requests hit compat fallback. Looks like a billing threshold bumped them to smaller model for a handful of requests.

alicia_cs: Action items: @sam_engineer take ownership for runtime change (schema-normalizer + better logs). @priya_infra investigate quota routing + token-rotation impact. @matt_support prepare support note for the customer with repro and short-term fixes. I'll draft the customer communication.

sam_engineer: Assigned. I can have a small validation/transform PR ready for review in ~24–48h.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: canary rollout of runtime fix branch `fn-schema-safety` scheduled for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC (ETA 30m). :rocket:

alicia_cs: Thanks team — @lexi_customer we'll follow up in the support ticket with exact steps and a timeline. If you can remove the old examples ASAP that should stop new errors while we implement server-side safety. :thumbsup:
